shellCommands.command: cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo "---"; ls -la /workspace/__agent_eval__; echo "---"; ls /workspace/node_modules | head -50

rm -f data/books.json && node server.js & sleep 0.7
echo "--- POST book 1 ---"
curl -s -X POST localhost:3000/api/books -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"Dune","author":"Frank Herbert","notes":"So far so good"}'
echo
echo "--- POST book 2 ---"
curl -s -X POST localhost:3000/api/books -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"The Hobbit","author":"Tolkien"}'
echo
echo "--- GET all ---"
curl -s localhost:3000/api/books
echo

ID=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('data/books.json'))[0].id)")
echo "--- mark finished ---"
curl -s -X PATCH localhost:3000/api/books/$ID -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"status":"finished"}'
echo
echo "--- get single book page ---"
curl -s localhost:3000/book/$ID | head -5
echo
echo "--- get index page ---"
curl -s localhost:3000/ | head -3
echo "--- 404 check ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:3000/api/books/doesnotexist
echo "--- restart persistence check ---"
cat data/books.json
